title: Put AICR in CI

scenes.heading: Which bundle reached the cluster?
voice: A GPU infrastructure team wants to know what its pipeline deployed.
The promotion needs one traceable artifact from build through validation.

scenes.heading: Build from recorded cluster facts
scenes.sub: Snapshot and recipe move with the build
voice: Start with a saved cluster snapshot and resolve the recipe for your workload.
Generate a bundle and store that output for the later verification and deployment stages.

scenes.heading: Make verification a promotion gate
scenes.sub: Send the verified build to the deployer
voice: Run bundle verification on the saved artifact before deployment.
If the bundle passes the configured checks and receives any required approval, give that same artifact to the deployment tooling.

scenes.heading: Check the running stack
scenes.sub: Use the recipe the deployer actually used
voice: After deployment, validate the running cluster against the recipe inside the bundle.
The report lets the team inspect the deployed stack and stop promotion if checks fail.

viewer: CI maintainer protecting a GPU-stack promotion
payoff: CI deploys the exact verified bundle and checks the running stack against the recipe carried inside it.
